cases.name: acceptance-5-seller-silent
cases.description: the buyer disputes a late delivery and the seller does not answer: the buyer's own book and its copy of the seller's are read, the seller's own book is not shown, and the delivery is timed by the buyer's linking fact

cases.name: acceptance-1-both-answer
cases.description: both answer: each held copy checks against the other side's own book; the buyer's own book extends the seller's copy of it (the longer is read, fork_at 0), and the delivery is timed by the seller's own stamp, earlier than the buyer's linking fact

cases.name: acceptance-3-opening-kept
cases.description: the buyer's case-opening selective copy and its later full answer are both read and agree

cases.name: holder-receipt-left-out
cases.description: the buyer leaves out the receipt of the stamp whose link first reached the delivery: the delivery is timed later (12:30), never earlier

cases.name: refuse-held-short-of-seen
cases.description: a held copy short of an own record's seen

cases.name: refuse-received-not-counterparty
cases.description: a received record not signed by the agreement's counterparty_key

cases.name: holder-fact-left-out
cases.description: the buyer leaves out its fact whose link first reached the delivery (its book's size did not change there, so the chain still holds): the delivery is timed later (12:30), never earlier

cases.name: refuse-first-fact-left-out
cases.description: the holder's facts without the first: the chain does not start at the book's first fact
cases.error: the first fact names a previous size

cases.name: refuse-evidence-of-another-book
cases.description: book evidence of another book than the answer's deal book

description: the adjudicator gathers four books (evidencebook#861, docs/design/861-four-books.md §2.3, §3.3; PROFILE §5 and §10): GatherCase(dispute, opening, answers, adjudicator_key, the shelf script's witness directory) gives want (the ruling's sources and read, and each side's book read with each record's time and what timed it), or refuses with error in its text. dispute and each report are hex; extension is the x-deal-v1 extension's text and evidence the text of an evidencebook.BookEvidence, as a host hands them over. Written by dealprofile/xdealv1's TestCaseGatherVectors (EB_WRITE_DEAL_V1_VECTORS=1).
